source_next_control_plane_recommendation: Define or constrain an explicit L1_NATIVE <-> carrier-contact bridge in one declared six-dimensional P000 model; retain FCC/HCP shell and Voronoi cases plus HCP non-central-symmetry as mandatory regressions.

gate_decisions.reason: The accepted classification closes the polyhedral census but leaves a precise model-interface gap: no theorem yet relates native adjacency to carrier contacts or carrier directions in a six-dimensional P000 model.
The accepted finite carrier classification is exact but is not being promoted to an L4 or formalization boundary in this review.

This review makes no novelty claim for the classical cuboctahedral, anticuboctahedral, or Dirichlet-domain facts; the return already source-checks those standard carrier structures. Any later novelty claim for a native-carrier bridge must be gated separately.

The finite result has an exact deterministic certificate and checker, and the Driver independently recomputed the decisive hull, incidence, central-symmetry, Barlow-local-type, and polar/Voronoi data before acceptance.
The result is classified RESULT_ONLY and the checker is task-local certification machinery rather than a new shared Enterprise tool family.

The result actively rejects the tempting 12/2 axis inference using the HCP non-central-symmetry counterexample and separates HULL1 from VOR and L1_NATIVE; the Driver independently rechecked those boundaries.
